data_output.description: data.load returns the existing split dictionaries with canonical source-row order. Each loaded row retains its existing positional structure, except feature position row[4] is hour_bin in 0..5 rather than raw hour. data.encode returns (encoded, dimension), where encoded[split] is (features, labels, users); features is an int32 array of shape (row_count, 5) with globally offset, train-vocabulary categorical IDs in the order user_id, video_id, tab, hour_bin, weekday. Every field, including hour_bin, has one train-fitted unknown bucket.

model_input.description: Model receives the unchanged five-column encoded categorical matrix. Column 3 (zero-based) is the train-fitted six-bin hour_bin categorical ID instead of the former train-fitted 24-category hour ID. No model architecture, loss, sampling, optimizer, regularization, checkpoint rule, or configuration value changes.
